title: A model profile's qualification record (agent-effectiveness synthesis 13.1 and 13.4; adoption record 10.3)
description: One provider/model through one pinned harness, in one capability class, and how far it is qualified. Reusable across experiments: a preregistration pins the profile's `ref`, and a run records the profile id with its qualification state. `qualification_state` is derived from `availability`, `floor` and `ceiling` (aew_eval.profiles.derive_state) and must agree with them. Never holds a credential: `credential_env` names variables only.

plan_role.description: Where the lane's plan uses it: the profile under qualification, the profile that replaces it when it becomes unavailable (a new experiment id), its fallback, the stable paid twin of a free model, or a model recorded only as a note.

twin_of.description: The id of the free profile this one is the paid twin of.

artifact_sha256.description: Per host platform, the sha256 of the pinned harness binary that was checked.

effective_profile.description: The AEW execution-profile settings a run of this profile uses (synthesis 13.2: context.orientation, tools.presentation); null where the arm has no AEW presentation (raw).

credential_env.description: Names of the provider variables the harness server needs; empty for a free model. Never values.

offered_by_pinned_harness.description: Whether the pinned harness's served catalog offered the model when checked (null: not checked).

catalog_status.description: The catalog's own status for the model (for example deprecated).

checked_with.description: What the check needed: for a paid model, a placeholder value for its variable (no provider call is made).

floor.description: The model completes the AEW bridge handshake and the typed submit path through the pinned harness.

ceiling.description: Lower-bound class only: the model still shows the weak-worker behaviours on the seeded lane.
